Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_guard_day_18_TEXT}The patrol route has just been changed, and there are people watching in the alleys back from the street.
Lines.Memory: 白天守卫正在维持交通、提醒扒手风险、检查城门并谈论巡逻。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_guard_night_01_TEXT}Who would like night shifts? The wind can always get in through the cracks in the armor.
Lines.Memory: 普通夜哨抱怨寒风、换岗、军饷和夜班漫长，但仍保持警惕。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_guard_night_02_TEXT}The changing of the guard won't happen for another two hours. It's going to be a long night.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_guard_night_03_TEXT}If the military pay is delayed any longer, the brothers will not even be able to drink hot wine.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_guard_night_04_TEXT}What I feared most at night was not the enemy, but the sudden rain and the lack of someone to take over.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_guard_night_05_TEXT}There was movement in the north just now, and I chased after it and realized it was a wild cat.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_tavern_general_01_TEXT}Respect to those who are still alive, and respect to the pub that will be open as usual tomorrow!
Lines.Memory: 酒馆里有人饮酒、谈规矩、商队消息、赌局和战争带来的疲惫。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_tavern_general_02_TEXT}Pay first and then pay on credit, this is the only unchanging rule of our store.
Lines.Memory: 酒馆里有人饮酒、谈规矩、商队消息、赌局和战争带来的疲惫。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_tavern_general_03_TEXT}The caravan from the south brought news, but they just refused to tell it in vain.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_tavern_general_04_TEXT}Don't sit near the door tonight, the cold wind is stronger than the wine.
Lines.Memory: 酒馆里有人饮酒、谈规矩、商队消息、赌局和战争带来的疲惫。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_tavern_general_05_TEXT}The people at the table have already lost three rounds, and if they continue to bet, they will have to pay for it with their boots.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_tavern_general_06_TEXT}Whether the war is fought or not is a matter for men. Let’s finish this cup first.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_singer_01_TEXT}For one dinar, you can sing a song about a distant battlefield!
Lines.Memory: 乐师正在招揽听众，可以演唱战争、爱情、海洋或最新传闻。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_singer_02_TEXT}Want to hear about love, war or the wind on the sea? Guests are welcome to order.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_singer_04_TEXT}A good story may not be true, but a good song must be worthy of applause.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_beggar_01_TEXT}Just give me a bite of bread to survive tonight.
Lines.Memory: 乞丐因饥饿、雨灾、税收、旧伤或孩子求助，也愿意寻找工作。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_beggar_02_TEXT}The rain last night washed away the nest, and I just wanted a dry place.
Lines.Memory: 乞丐因饥饿、雨灾、税收、旧伤或孩子求助，也愿意寻找工作。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_beggar_03_TEXT}The tax collector will not even spare the broken bowl of the beggar. What kind of worldly behavior is this?
Lines.Memory: 乞丐因饥饿、雨灾、税收、旧伤或孩子求助，也愿意寻找工作。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_beggar_04_TEXT}I also defended the city when I was young, but no one wanted me anymore after I injured my leg.
Lines.Memory: 乞丐因饥饿、雨灾、税收、旧伤或孩子求助，也愿意寻找工作。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_beggar_05_TEXT}Give it to the child. I can endure a hungry meal, but he can't.
Lines.Memory: 乞丐因饥饿、雨灾、税收、旧伤或孩子求助，也愿意寻找工作。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_beggar_06_TEXT}If you don't want to give me money, just tell me where I can find work.
Lines.Memory: 乞丐因饥饿、雨灾、税收、旧伤或孩子求助，也愿意寻找工作。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_blacksmith_01_TEXT}A good edge is not polished, but hammered.
Lines.Memory: 铁匠和学徒谈论锻造、木炭价格、修理武器盔甲与军队订单。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_blacksmith_02_TEXT}Recently, the price of charcoal has increased, and the cost of manicure can only rise accordingly.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_blacksmith_03_TEXT}If there is a gap in your weapon, you can still get out before dark.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_blacksmith_04_TEXT}This armor is too thin on the chest, so it's best to add another layer before going to the battlefield.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_merchant_accounts_01_TEXT}The price of salt has gone up today, and I heard that the convoy from the north has been delayed.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_merchant_accounts_02_TEXT}The color of the fabric should be seen under sunlight, as it is easy to see it wrong under a torch.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_merchant_accounts_03_TEXT}Business is about trustworthiness. It is better to earn less than to lose old customers.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_merchant_accounts_04_TEXT}If this batch of spices is sold after the rainy season, the taste will be reduced.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_merchant_accounts_05_TEXT}Stall rent has increased again, making it increasingly difficult to run a small business.

Lines.Memory: 领主大厅的守卫只谈来客登记、口信、接待、门禁和室内值守，不谈城墙或城门巡逻。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_001_TEXT}The wind today is blowing from the river, bringing a little moisture.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_002_TEXT}It didn't rain heavily last night, so the water in the well was quite clear.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_003_TEXT}This street always wakes up earlier than elsewhere in the morning.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_004_TEXT}This year's wheat crop looks good, I just hope it doesn't rain during harvest.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_005_TEXT}I heard that another convoy passed by on the south road last night.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_006_TEXT}The city has been quieter recently, and I feel more comfortable sleeping at night.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_007_TEXT}The children were chasing each other in the yard again, and no one could stop them.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_008_TEXT}The smell of that bakery spread so far today.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_009_TEXT}If the price of salt rises again this year, we won’t be able to afford cured meat.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_010_TEXT}The flag in the distance has changed its color. Is there a visitor entering the city?
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_011_TEXT}The sun isn't shining today, so it's a good time to take out the clothes to dry.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_012_TEXT}Last night someone told a story from a distant place, which kept me awake for half the night.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_013_TEXT}The old carpenter's craftsmanship is still unmatched after decades.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_014_TEXT}Someone's chicken ran onto the road again, it happens every day.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_015_TEXT}I have to get this basket delivered to my door before lunch.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_016_TEXT}I heard that the village in the north was short of manpower this year, and even the children went to help.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_017_TEXT}There were more unfamiliar faces on the road today than usual.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_018_TEXT}Although the stone roads in this city are old, they rarely accumulate water on rainy days.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_019_TEXT}The bell tower rang again, fearing that some distinguished guests were coming into the city.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_020_TEXT}If the weather stays like this, it will be easier to dry the millet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_021_TEXT}My youngest son always says he wants to see a real caravan.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_022_TEXT}Money has been spent so fast recently, and I can't always save a few pennies.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_023_TEXT}What are people over there looking at? Don't let someone fall into the ditch again.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_024_TEXT}If there were more wells, we wouldn't have to wait so long to carry water in the summer.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_025_TEXT}The threshold of that store has been repaired again and looks much stronger.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_026_TEXT}If there is no bad news this year, there will be a new bed in the house.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_027_TEXT}The sound of horse hooves just now sounded like people rushing on their way.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_028_TEXT}Someone is circulating that this year's tax rolls need to be rechecked.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_029_TEXT}I am not afraid of hard work, but I am afraid that there will be no buyers on the road.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_030_TEXT}The clouds dispersed quickly today, and it will probably be sunny tomorrow.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_031_TEXT}Don't stand in the middle of the road, there are cars behind you.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_032_TEXT}The dishes these days are fresher than usual, and everyone is grabbing them.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_033_TEXT}I still have some beans at home, which will be enough for dinner.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_034_TEXT}Who has extra needlework? My dress has become threadbare again.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_035_TEXT}I heard that guests from out of town like the honey here.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_036_TEXT}When I was a kid, I saw bigger markets, and they were so crowded.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_037_TEXT}There is no wind today and the smoke is drifting straight upward.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_038_TEXT}If the bridge could be made wider, the caravan would not have to wait outside the gate.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_039_TEXT}The children lined up the stones in a street, and they didn't know what they were playing with.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_commoner_040_TEXT}If the life is peaceful, it is actually very good.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_001_TEXT}If the price were lower, I could buy more copies.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_002_TEXT}Let me see the quality first, and I will talk about the price later.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_003_TEXT}I bought it on another street yesterday for much cheaper.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_004_TEXT}Don't rush to close the stall, I still need to pick out two more pieces of cloth.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_005_TEXT}Leave me a fresh fish and I'll pick it up later.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_006_TEXT}The wine tastes good, but the glass is too small.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_007_TEXT}I only brought this money, can I be considered cheaper?
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_008_TEXT}There are so many people today that there is no place to stay.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_009_TEXT}This batch of apples looked sweet, but smelled not yet ripe.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_010_TEXT}Watch your wallet, your hands and feet are not so clean today.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_011_TEXT}I first ask the neighboring stalls before deciding which one to buy.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_012_TEXT}If the caravan is still there tomorrow, I will buy the remaining goods together.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_013_TEXT}There are no cracks in this piece of leather, and I can accept the price.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_014_TEXT}Who still remembers how much the people at that table drank last night?
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_015_TEXT}Don’t leave all the good stuff to outsiders, locals have to live a good life too.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_customer_016_TEXT}If this transaction goes well, I can bring gifts to my children when I get home.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_001_TEXT}The newly arrived fabrics are all here, and the color and price can be negotiated.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_002_TEXT}Don’t just look at the cheapest one, the key is whether the goods are usable.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_003_TEXT}Most of today's guests are from West Road, and it seems to be quite peaceful there.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_004_TEXT}This batch of spices was hard to come by, and I would lose money if I missed even one copper coin.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_005_TEXT}If there is no buyer by the afternoon, I will move the goods to the port.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_006_TEXT}Don't leave your account books by the table, as the wind will blow them all into chaos.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_007_TEXT}This guest looks carefully and is a knowledgeable person.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_008_TEXT}If the sea breeze does not turn tonight, we will still receive a cargo tomorrow morning.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_009_TEXT}The tax collector came again, and today's profit was much less.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_010_TEXT}The biggest fear in buying and selling is that there is no news. News is more valuable than goods.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_011_TEXT}I will only stop here for three days, so don’t miss it if you want to buy it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_merchant_012_TEXT}Prices will change depending on the road, and today’s quote may not wait until tomorrow.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_001_TEXT}Don’t just look at the horse’s size, look at its teeth first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_002_TEXT}This gray horse has a stubborn temper, but has great stamina for long distances.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_003_TEXT}I need to prepare more water today. There are more guests in the stable than usual.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_004_TEXT}Don't let the pony near the fence, as he will break free at the sight of the rope.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_005_TEXT}The two horses that just arrived last night are still getting used to the feed here.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_006_TEXT}If the rider takes care of his mount, the horse will remember this love.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_007_TEXT}The horseshoe is loose, and I have to find a blacksmith to nail it again in the afternoon.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_horse_trader_008_TEXT}A good horse is not afraid of walking a long way, but is afraid that its owner is reluctant to let it rest.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_001_TEXT}If the heat is not enough, the hammered edge will not last long.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_002_TEXT}The coal is burning brightly today, and we are just in time to catch a batch of farm tools.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_003_TEXT}Don't mix pig iron and wrought iron together, as the properties of the products will be different.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_004_TEXT}This old sword can still be salvaged, and a different handle will give it a few more years of use.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_005_TEXT}Sparks fell on the board. Get water quickly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_006_TEXT}The customer's ax was ground too thin and any further sharpening would damage the edge.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_007_TEXT}I would rather hand it over a moment later than hand over the iron that is not cold enough.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_blacksmith_008_TEXT}The anvil is polished and the sound is different when struck.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_001_TEXT}There is nothing unusual in this section of the street, and pedestrians are doing business as usual.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_002_TEXT}After changing the post, I took a drink of water first. After carrying this spear for a long time, it became heavier than a man.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_003_TEXT}The motorcade at the door has been registered and can be released.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_004_TEXT}It's windy and sandy today, and my eyes are full of gray.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_005_TEXT}Keep children away from the carriage; the driver cannot see them.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_006_TEXT}After this shift, I'm going to see if the military supplies have been delivered.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_007_TEXT}There have been a lot of people patrolling these days, so everyone has restrained themselves a lot.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_008_TEXT}Don't draw your sword without an order. The people in the city will be frightened when they see it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_009_TEXT}I waited until the rain stopped before changing my shift. My nails were almost rusty.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_soldier_010_TEXT}The password has been changed today, don’t let anyone you don’t know sneak in.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_001_TEXT}The window seat is reserved, so don't leave your cup there.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_002_TEXT}The hot soup will be served immediately, just out of the pot, so be careful not to burn it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_003_TEXT}Tonight's guests are all talking about the news on the road.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_004_TEXT}Don't fill up the wine, there's a table waiting behind you.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_005_TEXT}That guest drank too much. Who can help me persuade him to go outside?
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_006_TEXT}There is not enough bread today. I will order two more baskets tomorrow morning.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_007_TEXT}Be quiet, the guests upstairs have gone to bed.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_tavernkeeper_008_TEXT}If there hadn't been any trouble tonight, I would have been able to close earlier.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_001_TEXT}When the song reaches the chorus, everyone remembers to clap together.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_002_TEXT}The strings are loose, wait for me to tune them before singing the next one.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_003_TEXT}There are many stories about this city. Let’s sing the part about Boatman first tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_004_TEXT}Don't think this song is old, only old songs can be sung by people.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_005_TEXT}The kids over there want to hear something faster, and it looks like they won’t be left alone tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_006_TEXT}After singing this part, I took a break and my throat almost started to smoke.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_007_TEXT}If anyone is willing to give me a reward, I can sing another hometown song.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_musician_008_TEXT}People who hear this melody are probably thinking of their hometown.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_beggar_001_TEXT}Okay, okay, a mouthful of hot soup can save my day.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_beggar_002_TEXT}I'm not asking for much, just a dry corner tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_beggar_003_TEXT}May the good weather also come to good-hearted people.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_beggar_004_TEXT}I used to have a house, but I can't go back now.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_beggar_005_TEXT}Don't chase me away, I won't stand in the way of my guests.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_beggar_006_TEXT}A small amount of money is enough for me to take the side medicine, please.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_shipwright_001_TEXT}The tide is rising fast today, so the wood needs to be moved to higher ground first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_shipwright_002_TEXT}The mast of the ship has not been fixed yet, and no one is allowed to get on it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_shipwright_003_TEXT}The fish should be weighed first and don't mix small fish into the big basket.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_shipwright_004_TEXT}The wind was blowing in the wrong direction and it was not a good day to get the boat out of the harbor.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_shipwright_005_TEXT}Tighten the rope, otherwise the cargo box will fall into the water if it shakes any more.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_shipwright_006_TEXT}The cracks in the bottom of the boat are not big, and there is still time to repair them tonight.

TextVariants: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_01}The stone road was still a little damp in the morning, so be careful when walking.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_02}When the wind blows, all the ashes on the street rise.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_03}The clouds are so low that it will probably rain in the afternoon.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_04}The sun finally came out, and the bedding in the house could also bask in the sun.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_05}Today is cooler than yesterday, making things much easier.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_06}The thunder last night was so loud that even the window frames were shaking.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_07}There was fog on the river, and the shadows of the boats in the distance could not be seen clearly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_08}The wind blew in from the mountain pass, and my ears almost froze.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_09}Sunny days like this are rare, perfect for drying grain and drying salt.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_10}There is an earthy smell in the air, it must have just rained nearby.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_11}The ice on the eaves melted, and the sound of water dripping didn't stop for a moment.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_12}There was no wind today and I didn’t even bother to move the flag.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_13}Judging from the color of the sunset, it shouldn't rain tomorrow.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_14}The morning fog cleared slowly, and people leaving the city were waiting at the door.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_15}When the weather gets hot, more people line up at the well.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_16}At this time of year, it is cold in the morning and evening and hot at noon, so children are most likely to catch cold.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_17}The rain stopped just in time, and it would be impossible to walk again.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_18}The wind was full of dust, and the clothes hanging outside were stiff.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_19}The sun sets earlier and earlier, so I have to get the work done quickly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_01_VARIANT_20}The air is very stuffy, I'm afraid I won't be able to sleep well tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_01}We only have enough flour for two days at home, and we have to come back tomorrow morning.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_02}Children grow up so fast that last year’s shoes no longer fit.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_03}Make a pot of bean soup tonight and have leftovers to take to work tomorrow.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_04}The old man's cough has come back again. I have to find some honey.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_05}The cat at home caught a big mouse last night.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_06}The newly bought clay pot leaked, so I had to ask the stall owner to replace it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_07}My mother always said that you should start saving winter firewood in the spring.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_08}The younger son learned to write his own name and was very happy all day long.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_09}Add a handful of herbs to dinner, and whole grains can be eaten deliciously.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_10}The wooden board on the roof was loose again, and it creaked when the wind blew.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_11}The basket the neighbor borrowed hasn't been returned yet, so I almost forgot about it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_12}If there are many people in the family, one piece of cake can be eaten by breaking it into several portions.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_13}My sister is getting married next month and the whole family is preparing gifts.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_14}Although the old blanket is thin, it can survive the winter by sewing two layers on it.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_15}That hen hasn't laid eggs recently, probably because she was frightened.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_16}My children always ask what is outside the city, but I can’t tell myself.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_17}The wooden box my father left behind is still strong and will be fine for another ten years.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_18}It was rare for the whole family to sit together last night, and the food was more delicious than usual.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_19}If I can save a little this month, I will buy a new pair of shoes for my mother.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_02_VARIANT_20}When there is hot food in the house and a light on, people are content.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_01}I heard that the road to the east is open and the caravan will be back soon.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_02}Yesterday, someone came from the north and said that food prices there have risen sharply.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_03}There are a few strange carriages on the roadside, and I don’t know who they belong to.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_04}The inn was brightly lit last night, and an urgent message must have been delivered.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_05}The dye brought by that caravan was so bright.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_06}Some people say they saw wolves on the mountain road, but I don’t know if it’s true or not.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_07}Travelers from the south are asking where they can get dry food.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_08}If freight transportation goes smoother, the price of salt should drop a bit.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_09}There are more foreign accents recently, and the nearby residences are probably full.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_10}The bridge that was broken a few days ago was repaired, and bullock carts were finally able to cross.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_11}A storyteller has just arrived. There may be many people listening to the stories at night.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_12}I heard that there was a new tax collector in a neighboring city, and the merchants were waiting to see what happened.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_13}A group of hunters left the city early in the morning and have not returned yet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_14}There are more checkpoints on the road than before, and delivery times are also longer.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_15}The wine from the west has a strong taste and the price is exorbitantly high.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_16}Some people are buying old copperware, even broken pots.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_17}The bell rang louder than usual this morning. I don’t know what happened.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_18}A new shed was erected at the entrance of the village, as if a market was being held.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_19}A traveler said he saw snow falling on the top of a mountain in the distance.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_03_VARIANT_20}As long as the roads are safe, life in the city won't be too difficult.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_01}The work on my shoulders hasn't been lifted yet, and I'm afraid my back will hurt again at night.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_02}I have to make two more trips today, and my family is waiting for the wages.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_03}Hemp rope will break after being used for a long time, so be sure to check it before moving heavy objects.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_04}This piece of wood is too wet to be used for roofing.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_05}After finishing the work before lunch, I can go to help my neighbor repair the door in the afternoon.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_06}My hands are calloused, but I am no longer afraid of rough work.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_07}The handle of the bucket is loose, and it will fall off when it is filled again.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_commoner_04_VARIANT_08}The path is too narrow and the cart always hits the wall.

{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_06}If you have any old shoes that you don’t want, please save a pair for me.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_07}I will help move things, just ask for some food.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_08}No one has given alms today, but it is almost dark.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_09}Give some to the child, he can't stand hunger even more than I can.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_10}I didn't dare to enter the store, so I could only smell the fragrance outside the door.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_11}One copper coin is not much, but it can last me until tomorrow.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_12}When it rains, water will enter the bridge. I don't know where to sleep tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_13}Good people will always be rewarded, I can only wish you this.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_14}If this blanket gets torn again, I will really have nothing to cover myself with.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_15}I used to do woodwork, but this hand was injured.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_16}Please don't rush me, I'll leave after a while.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_17}Does anyone have half a bowl of soup left? It can also be served cold.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_18}Winter hasn't arrived yet, but my bones are already feeling cold.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_19}I remember my old home, but I don’t remember the way back.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_beggar_01_VARIANT_20}May someone see me today instead of walk past me.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_01}Don't tie the rope tightly, as the tide will break the stakes.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_02}This ship plank has straight grain and is perfect for the side.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_03}The asphalt hasn't boiled yet, so don't rush to fill in the cracks yet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_04}All the seabirds are flying to the shore, and the weather outside may be bad.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_05}The cargo box was placed lightly on the upper floor and heavily pressed against the bottom of the ship.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_06}The boat was too deep and must have been overfilled.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_07}The edge of the paddle is cracked, and it will break after a few more miles of rowing.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_08}Spread the fishing net out to dry, otherwise it will smell musty tomorrow morning.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_09}The waves today are not big, so it is suitable for dragging the boat ashore for repairs.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_10}You are not afraid of water leaking from the bow of the boat. What you are afraid of is that you cannot find where the leak is.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_11}Salt water damages iron parts the most, and they have to be re-oiled every time they dock.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_12}No one can push the boat in until the tide goes out.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_13}The lid of the barrel must be tightly pressed, as anything may be spilled if the sea sways.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_14}This gust of wind is coming quickly, so let’s take down all the sails first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_15}The dock's gangplank is slippery, so watch your feet carefully when moving goods.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_16}Navigation is not just about looking at maps, but also about looking at clouds and birds.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_17}The mast rigging had become fluffed and had to be replaced before leaving port.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_18}There should be ventilation openings in the cabin, otherwise the food will spoil quickly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_19}A good shipwright can tell by the knocking sound whether there is any space in the plank.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_shipwright_01_VARIANT_20}When this boat is launched, I can finally get a full night's sleep.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_01}The color of this cloth is beautiful, and I don’t know if it will fade even after washing it a few times.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_02}If the child wants to come to see me in the afternoon, he must finish his work first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_03}I can move it alone, I just have to walk more slowly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_04}The herbal medicine my mother taught me is really useful for relieving coughs.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_05}The flour I bought today is fine, so I can bake some soft pancakes tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_06}Don't worry about me, I walk this road every day.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_07}The girl next door is very skillful and can make old clothes look like new ones.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_08}The family's accounts have to be settled one by one, and even one copper coin will not make it through the month.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_09}I want to leave some dowry for my daughter, no matter how small it is, I have to save it slowly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_10}These hands are used to doing the work, and the cracks don’t hurt in winter.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_11}Who says women don’t understand business? I can tell at a glance whether the price is good or bad.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_12}My boy has torn the leg of his trousers again and needs to be mended tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_13}The food in the morning market is fresher, so I would rather get up earlier.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_14}This scarf was knitted by my sister. It has many threads but is very warm.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_15}When doing things outside alone, it never hurts to be cautious.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_16}I promised to bring candy to the child, but I couldn’t go back empty-handed.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_17}Neighbors look after each other so that life can go on.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_18}I protected this basket of eggs all the way without breaking any of them.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_19}After I finish the work at hand, I also want to listen to a night of singing.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_extra_pool_female_commoner_01_VARIANT_20}No matter how busy your life is, you won’t feel tired when you come home and see the lights on.

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_market_bargain_anchor_TEXT}If the price were more reasonable, I would buy both.
Lines.Memory: 顾客正在就眼前货物和商贩讨价还价，旁人只适合谈价格、品质或邻摊比较。
ReplyHints: 商贩可说明成本、品质或能让出的价钱
顾客可比较数量、成色或旁边摊位
只写当场说出口的话，不写动作、神态和旁白

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_market_bargain_reply_01_TEXT}It's already today's low price. If it's any less, I'll lose money.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_market_bargain_reply_02_TEXT}Don't rush to agree yet, you haven't looked at the goods at the stall next to me yet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_weather_anchor_TEXT}The clouds are so low that it may rain in the afternoon.
Lines.Memory: 居民正在根据低云谈论可能到来的雨，话题应落在晾晒、赶路或庄稼上。
ReplyHints: 居民可担心衣物、货物或道路被雨淋湿
村民可谈雨水对播种或收成的影响
只写自然口语，不预言灾难，不写动作和旁白

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_weather_reply_01_TEXT}Then I have to take my clothes back quickly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_weather_reply_02_TEXT}As long as it doesn't rain right before the wheat harvest, it won't matter if it rains.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_tavern_story_anchor_TEXT}When the song reaches the chorus, everyone remembers to clap together.
Lines.Memory: 酒馆乐手正邀请客人参与一首熟悉的曲子，接话应围绕曲目、音量和客人反应。
ReplyHints: 客人可点一首熟悉的歌、应和或开一句善意玩笑
酒馆雇员可提醒音量、秩序或楼上住客
只写说出口的话，不写唱歌动作、拍手动作和旁白

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_tavern_story_reply_01_TEXT}Sing a song that everyone knows first, don't let the new guests sit still.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_tavern_story_reply_02_TEXT}Keep your voice down, the guests upstairs haven't woken up yet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_horse_anchor_TEXT}Don’t just look at the horse’s size, look at its teeth first.
Lines.Memory: 马匹从业者正在向顾客讲解挑马，接话只应围绕牙口、耐力、脾性和用途。
ReplyHints: 马商或马夫可谈牙口、腿脚、耐力和照料
顾客可说明长途、载货或乘骑需求
不要谈锻造或普通货摊，只写当场口语

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_horse_reply_01_TEXT}I just want a horse that can go a long way, not a beautiful one.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_horse_reply_02_TEXT}My old horse has a bad tooth, but he still pulled the truck for ten years.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_smith_anchor_TEXT}This piece of iron has not yet cooled down, so no one should be in a hurry to take it away.
Lines.Memory: 铁匠正在提醒顾客等待工件冷却，接话应围绕火候、铁料、牢固程度和工期。
ReplyHints: 铁匠可解释火候、淬火、材料或赶工风险
顾客可询问工期、耐用程度或修理结果
不要把普通商贩写成铁匠，只写说出口的话

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_smith_reply_01_TEXT}I'm in no rush, the solid stuff is worth the wait.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_smith_reply_02_TEXT}You are right, rushing to work is the easiest way to destroy good materials.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_guard_anchor_TEXT}Pull the car to the side and don't block the road.
Lines.Memory: 街道或城门附近的士兵正在疏通车辆，接话应围绕道路、卸货和通行秩序。
ReplyHints: 士兵可继续提醒让路、排队或城门通行
居民和车夫可回应挪车、卸货或前方拥堵
不要提领主大厅巡墙，只写现场能说出口的话

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_guard_reply_01_TEXT}Got it, now give way to the car behind you.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_guard_reply_02_TEXT}The people unloading the goods ahead heard it, and the road would soon be clear.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_village_harvest_anchor_TEXT}If there is no bad weather this year, the harvest should be enough for the whole village to survive the winter.
Lines.Memory: 村民正在估量本年收成能否过冬，接话应围绕农田、水渠、天气、盗匪和储粮。
ReplyHints: 村民可谈水渠、播种、收割、储粮或牲畜
可担忧天气和盗匪，但不要凭空宣布灾情
只写朴素的村民口语，不写动作和旁白

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_village_harvest_reply_01_TEXT}Once the ditches are cleared, the seedlings in the fields will have more hope.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_village_harvest_reply_02_TEXT}As long as the bandits don't come, everyone is willing to be more tired.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_port_arrival_anchor_TEXT}The bow of the ship entered the harbor and prepared the vacated rope piles.
Lines.Memory: 港口工人正在为船只靠岸和卸货作准备，接话应围绕缆绳、潮水、舱货和受潮风险。
ReplyHints: 船工、水手可谈缆绳、泊位、潮水和卸货顺序
商贩可关心货物是否受潮及到货后的行情
不要把港工写成铁匠或马商，只写现场口语

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_port_arrival_reply_01_TEXT}Planks and buckets have been delivered and can be unloaded once they reach the shore.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_port_arrival_reply_02_TEXT}If the goods are not affected by moisture, the price in the market tomorrow will be easier to negotiate.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_beggar_kindness_anchor_TEXT}Okay, okay, a mouthful of hot soup can save my day.
Lines.Memory: 乞丐正在恳求一点食物，周围人的回应应围绕面包、热汤和力所能及的帮助。
ReplyHints: 居民可给少量面包、指点施粥处或委婉拒绝
酒馆雇员只可在酒馆谈剩饭和热汤
保持克制和生活感，不写动作、道德说教或旁白

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_beggar_kindness_reply_01_TEXT}I have half a loaf of bread here. You can take it first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_beggar_kindness_reply_02_TEXT}When this table of guests has finished, I'll serve you a bowl of hot soup.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_laughter_anchor_TEXT}Have you heard about it? The donkey ate all the carrots.
Lines.Memory: 居民正在拿驴偷吃萝卜的街坊趣事开玩笑，接话应延续这件小事。
ReplyHints: 围绕驴、萝卜、货车和倒霉车夫接一句轻松玩笑
可以夸张一点，但不要引入战争、税收或政治
只写简短口语，不解释笑点，不写动作和旁白

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_laughter_reply_01_TEXT}No wonder the coachman called it all the way, and it thought it was urging it to continue eating.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_event_laughter_reply_02_TEXT}If it even gnawed the wheels, today's transaction would really be a story.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_01_TEXT}The next piece of music is dedicated to tonight’s host and distinguished guests.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_02_TEXT}This melody is slower, just enough so that the conversation is not interrupted.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_03_TEXT}The nobles are talking about battlefields and fiefdoms. I try not to let the banquet get cold.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_04_TEXT}If you like it, I can change it to a more solemn song.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_05_TEXT}The echo of this hall is very good, and the strings do not need to be plucked too hard.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_06_TEXT}Tonight's repertoire is very full, and it seems that the host is very attentive to his guests.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_07_TEXT}This old tune is often ordered at banquets in the north.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_08_TEXT}Please don't rush, the good ending should be reserved for the last glass of wine.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_09_TEXT}I have heard of many banquets, but not many can fill such a table with distinguished guests.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_10_TEXT}May this piece of music serve as a toast to you all.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_11_TEXT}I just hope that I don't play a wrong note during the quietest time.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_12_TEXT}The beat of this piece is more steady, which is suitable for you to talk slowly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_13_TEXT}The grander the feast, the more the musician has to know when to shut up.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_14_TEXT}It's enough to hear the laughter, it doesn't have to be a soundtrack to every sentence.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_15_TEXT}Anyone want to hear old songs? I try not to sing too loudly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_16_TEXT}The host's flag was hung high, and even the wind outside seemed to be congratulating.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_17_TEXT}{player_title} is here in person, so you can’t play the wrong song tonight.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_musician_18_TEXT}It is a rare honor for a musician to be able to accompany such a banquet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_01_TEXT}The wine has been poured. Sir, please use it slowly.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_02_TEXT}This pot is for the main table. Please wait a moment for the table next to you.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_03_TEXT}Please pass the empty glass and don't let the waiter squeeze back and forth among the distinguished guests.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_04_TEXT}This dish has just come out of the pan. If you are not in a hurry, I will let it cool for you first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_05_TEXT}The wine tonight is stronger than usual, please don't drink one glass after another.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_06_TEXT}The host has ordered that the guests’ needs should be noted down.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_07_TEXT}The table was so engrossed in the conversation just now that no one even noticed that the wine was spilled.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_08_TEXT}The nobles are chatting all over the world, and I'm just worried that this silver pot won't be knocked over.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_09_TEXT}If I bring this plate over again, the kitchen will probably scold me for being too slow.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_10_TEXT}Anyone want hot soup? If you sit for a long time at night, your stomach will complain first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_11_TEXT}Please be quieter, the head table is talking.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_12_TEXT}There were so many guests tonight that I was so busy that I almost forgot what my name was.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_13_TEXT}As long as the adult raised his hand, I knew it was time to add more wine.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_14_TEXT}The cup for {player_title} must be filled first. The host cannot serve guests with an empty cup.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_15_TEXT}If you don't want to drink, I can replace it with water, and no one at the banquet will force you to do anything.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_16_TEXT}The dishes have been collected for three rounds, but their conversation is not even half over yet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_17_TEXT}Enjoy your meal, but please don't leave grape seeds on the carpet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_server_18_TEXT}Some guests prefer strong wines and some prefer liqueurs, and it's easier to remember that than the names.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_01_TEXT}Please keep the passage clear for all of you to come in and out.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_02_TEXT}Everything is safe outside the door, you can talk with peace of mind.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_03_TEXT}It's still early for the changing of the guard, let the distinguished guest finish his words first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_04_TEXT}Tonight's armor was polished brighter than usual, and he had to stand firmer on guard.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_05_TEXT}If anyone needs to leave, please tell the guard at the door first.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_06_TEXT}The laughter can be loud at the banquet, but the weapons in hand cannot be moved.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_07_TEXT}The host has invited so many distinguished guests, so the guard outside the city gate cannot be relaxed.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_08_TEXT}I've seen celebration banquets after victory, and this one was quieter than those.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_09_TEXT}If there is an emergency report outside, someone will come to pass it on, so there is no need to alert the main table with every step.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_10_TEXT}I hope you all have a great time tonight, and I hope my changing of the guard will not be postponed any longer.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_11_TEXT}You stand by the door and listen the most, but you don’t have to interrupt every sentence.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_12_TEXT}The wine glasses of nobles clink crisply, and the scabbards of swords outside the door must also be quiet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_13_TEXT}Seeing {player_title} present, tonight's escort cannot make any mistakes.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_14_TEXT}If someone at the main table wants to go out, I will make way for him.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_15_TEXT}The more honorable the banquet, the more important it is for the gatekeeper to remember where he should stand.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_16_TEXT}I don't understand the state affairs they discussed, but I can tell that the host attaches great importance to this banquet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_17_TEXT}As long as the guests came in and out safely, the night was considered a good one.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_feast_guard_18_TEXT}To be able to seat so many distinguished guests under one roof, the host's prestige is indeed extraordinary.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_01_TEXT}Run! There's a knife going on in the street, don't stand here!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_02_TEXT}It's a coup... Someone wants to seize the throne, close the door!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_03_TEXT}Where is the child? Who saw where my child ran?
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_04_TEXT}Don't hurt us, we are just local people!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_05_TEXT}The defenders are coming. Hide in the alley!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_06_TEXT}{player_title}'s troops have entered the city, and things are going to change today!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_07_TEXT}We don’t need the stall anymore, it’s important to save our lives!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_civilian_08_TEXT}God forbid, don't let the fire burn down the house.
Lines.Memory: 政变中的城镇街道上，惊慌的居民一边逃命一边议论有人夺权、守军厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_merchant_01_TEXT}My shop! Who will take care of it? Is this going to be an open robbery?
Lines.Memory: 政变中的商贩担心铺子和货物，急着收摊闭门。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_merchant_02_TEXT}Close the stall, close the stall, this business can't be done today.
Lines.Memory: 政变中的商贩担心铺子和货物，急着收摊闭门。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_merchant_03_TEXT}I don't care who becomes the king, just don't destroy my goods!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的商贩担心铺子和货物，急着收摊闭门。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_merchant_04_TEXT}The door is bolted, no one can come in until the fight is over!
Lines.Memory: 政变中的商贩担心铺子和货物，急着收摊闭门。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_beggar_01_TEXT}When adults fight, we are always the unlucky ones.
Lines.Memory: 政变街道上的流浪者和艺人四处躲藏，只求不被卷进厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_beggar_02_TEXT}Don't run over there, there are soldiers there too!
Lines.Memory: 政变街道上的流浪者和艺人四处躲藏，只求不被卷进厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_beggar_03_TEXT}I saw nothing, heard nothing.
Lines.Memory: 政变街道上的流浪者和艺人四处躲藏，只求不被卷进厮杀。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_servant_01_TEXT}They burst into the hall! Go and protect His Majesty... No, run away!
Lines.Memory: 政变攻入领主大厅时，仆从惊恐躲避，不知该向谁效忠。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_servant_02_TEXT}Don't kill me, I'm just a servant serving wine!
Lines.Memory: 政变攻入领主大厅时，仆从惊恐躲避，不知该向谁效忠。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_servant_03_TEXT}There is blood in front of the throne... Is this still the Lord's Hall?
Lines.Memory: 政变攻入领主大厅时，仆从惊恐躲避，不知该向谁效忠。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_servant_04_TEXT}The guards all fell... Who should we listen to in the future?
Lines.Memory: 政变攻入领主大厅时，仆从惊恐躲避，不知该向谁效忠。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_servant_05_TEXT}Hide under the table and be silent!
Lines.Memory: 政变攻入领主大厅时，仆从惊恐躲避，不知该向谁效忠。

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_panic_anchor_01_TEXT}Someone shouted on the street that the king was about to change!
Lines.Memory: 政变街道上，居民们互相传话，商量往哪里躲避战火。
ReplyHints: 只写居民当场说出口的逃命、躲避或传话

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_panic_anchor_02_TEXT}There was a fight between the defenders and the foreign soldiers. Which way should they flee?
Lines.Memory: 政变街道上，居民们互相传话，商量往哪里躲避战火。
ReplyHints: 只写居民当场说出口的逃命、躲避或传话

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_panic_reply_01_TEXT}Don't ask, let's go inside first!
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_panic_reply_02_TEXT}Go to the city gate, there's no fighting there yet.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_panic_reply_03_TEXT}The lord's hall is full of soldiers, so don't go there!
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_street_panic_reply_04_TEXT}It doesn't matter who is the king, what matters is survival.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_panic_anchor_01_TEXT}The door to the hall was knocked open, and His Majesty's guards could not stop it!
Lines.Memory: 政变攻入领主大厅时，仆从们低声商量如何躲避。
ReplyHints: 只写仆从当场说出口的躲避或惊慌之语

Lines.Text: {=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_panic_reply_01_TEXT}Get out of the kitchen door, quickly!
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_panic_reply_02_TEXT}Be quiet and wait until they finish.
{=AF_CONV_AMBIENT_coup_hall_panic_reply_03_TEXT}This time the throne really needs to be replaced.
